scope: One completed fresh candidate training run, validation loss evaluation and separately recorded matched 20-case development comparison. The candidate remains experimental and v2 remains the default.
candidate_origin: New rank-16 LoRA adapter initialized from the pinned base model; the released v2 adapter is preserved.

hardware_configuration_from_prior_prefli.limitation: A prior one-example forward/backward check with approximated optimizer-state buffers does not establish full-run memory usage or successful training.

candidate_promotion.decision: Do not promote. Primary placement improves 38 to 46 units and repairs fall 68 to 59, but critical errors rise 2 to 3, including new cause/commitment errors. Changed failed groups and a primary administrative placement regression also require investigation.
candidate_promotion.reserved_integrity_note: Earlier automated integrity checks inspected reserved dataset bytes; no reserved model evaluation or semantic review was used.

resume_note: Before resuming an interrupted run, confirm checkpoint adapter weights, trainer_state.json, optimizer.pt, scheduler.pt and RNG state are present. The installed Trainer can skip absent optimizer/scheduler state.
initial_capture_scope: CPU-only provenance capture made while training was active; historical preflight hardware details remain labeled as such.
metric_limits: Loss measures fit to programmatically authored examples, not semantic correctness or usefulness. Training wall_seconds and CUDA allocator memory peaks are captured before the separate final validation pass. Elapsed training/evaluation durations come from timers rather than wall-clock timestamp differences.

memory_interpretation.limitation: The recorded allocator reservation exceeds the GPU's physical VRAM. PyTorch distinguishes tensor allocations from total memory managed by its caching allocator. Physical residency and shared-memory peaks were not captured, and the cause of the above-capacity reservation was not established; this run does not establish that all training memory remained within 16 GB of dedicated VRAM.
memory_interpretation.next_check: Profile physical and shared memory plus allocator growth before making a strict dedicated-VRAM budget claim.

comparison_timing_note: reports/V3-RUN-NOTES.json qualifies the long observation/session gap. The original comparison timers and outputs are preserved; no speed comparison is claimed.
